title: Sardinhas Assadas
description: A traditional Portugal dish made with sardine, sea salt, lemon, parsley. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 15 minutes.
Grill over medium-high heat for about 12 minutes, turning regularly until charred outside and safely cooked inside.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
